Asips fables, the fox and the crow.
A crow was sitting on a branch of a tree with a piece of cheese in her beak, when a fox
observed her and set his wits to work, to discover some way of getting the cheese.
Coming and standing under the tree he looked up and said, What a noble bird I see above
Her beauty is without equal, the hue of her plumage exquisite.
exquisite. If only her voice is as sweet as her looks are fair. She ought without doubt
